connector.name: FaxSeal
connector.registryDescription: Send, receive, and verify faxes from AI assistants and agents via FaxSeal.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp-server-production-8f66.up.railway.app over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package faxseal-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the grichardomi account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
